description.en: Generic low-centered ice-wedge polygon ground teaching module. NPS Swanson explains contraction cracks, repeated freezing and raised margins around lower wetter centers; aerial photos establish irregular connected networks. Nominal45x40m footprint,3m cut soil section and0.7m relief artistic, not surveyed study site, age or current permafrost trend. Ice wedges are buried, no exposed surface ice required.
